answer: Re-attestations are stored in marble and delta lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the prism graph. A farm of 1678 identities would post 2593 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
